public.text: The statement that foundational exchange is recommended across networks but not required between co-located systems could be misread as allowing co-located systems to bypass national data, semantic, security, and audit requirements.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify that co-located systems may use direct local integration but should still conform to applicable national information models, terminology, security, provenance, audit, and interface requirements.
